verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלַ֛ח יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא מִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֶל־ יֶ֜תֶר זִקְנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֗ה וְאֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְאֶל־ הַנְּבִיאִים֙ וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶגְלָ֧ה נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֛ר מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh diḇ·rê has·sê·p̄er ’ă·šer šā·laḥ yir·mə·yāh han·nā·ḇî mî·rū·šā·lim ’el- ye·ṯer ziq·nê hag·gō·w·lāh wə·’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·’el- han·nə·ḇî·’îm wə·’el- kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer heḡ·lāh nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar mî·rū·šā·lim bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: This is the text of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests . . . the prophets . . . and all the others Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Ora, são estas as palavras da carta que o profeta Jeremias enviou de Jerusalém aos que restavam dos anciãos do cativeiro, e aos sacerdotes, e aos profetas, e a todo o povo que Nabucodonosor levara cativos de Jerusalém para Babilônia,

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י צֵ֣את יְכָנְיָֽה־ הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ וְהַגְּבִירָ֨ה וְהַסָּרִיסִ֜ים שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֧ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְהֶחָרָ֥שׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּ֖ר מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê ṣêṯ yə·ḵā·nə·yāh- ham·me·leḵ wə·hag·gə·ḇî·rāh wə·has·sā·rî·sîm śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim wə·he·ḥā·rāš wə·ham·mas·gêr mî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: This was after King Jeconiah the queen mother the court officials the officials of Judah and Jerusalem the craftsmen and the metalsmiths had been exiled from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: depois que saíram de Jerusalém o rei Jeconias, e a rainha-mãe, e os eunucos, e os príncipes de Judá e Jerusalém, e os artífices, e os ferreiros.

verses.original: בְּיַד֙ אֶלְעָשָׂ֣ה בֶן־ שָׁפָ֔ן וּגְמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח צִדְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל־ נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֛ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּבֶ֥לָה לֵאמֹֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·yaḏ ’el·‘ā·śāh ḇen- šā·p̄ān ū·ḡə·mar·yāh ben- ḥil·qî·yāh ’ă·šer šā·laḥ ṣiḏ·qî·yāh me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’el- nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel bā·ḇe·lāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: The letter was entrusted to Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon . . . It stated
verses.literalPt: Estas são as palavras da carta mandada por mão de Elasa, filho de Safã, e de Gemarias, filho de Hilquias (os quais enviou Zedequias, rei de Judá, a Babilônia, a Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia):

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְכָל־ הַ֨גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִגְלֵ֥יתִי מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·lāh ’ă·šer- hiḡ·lê·ṯî mî·rū·šā·lim bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says to all the exiles who were carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, a todos os do cativeiro que fiz levar cativos de Jerusalém para Babilônia:

verses.original: בְּנ֥וּ בָתִּ֖ים וְשֵׁ֑בוּ וְנִטְע֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְאִכְל֖וּ אֶת־ פִּרְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nū ḇāt·tîm wə·šê·ḇū wə·niṭ·‘ū ḡan·nō·wṯ wə·’iḵ·lū ’eṯ- pir·yān
verses.literal: Build houses and settle down Plant gardens and eat their produce
verses.literalPt: Edificai casas e habitai nelas; plantai jardins e comei o fruto deles;

verses.original: קְח֣וּ נָשִׁ֗ים וְהוֹלִידוּ֮ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנוֹת֒ וּקְח֨וּ לִבְנֵיכֶ֜ם נָשִׁ֗ים וְאֶת־ בְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ תְּנ֣וּ לַֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְתֵלַ֖דְנָה בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֑וֹת וּרְבוּ־ שָׁ֖ם וְאַל־ תִּמְעָֽטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḥū nā·šîm wə·hō·w·lî·ḏū bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ ū·qə·ḥū liḇ·nê·ḵem nā·šîm wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem tə·nū la·’ă·nā·šîm wə·ṯê·laḏ·nāh bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ ū·rə·ḇū- šām wə·’al- tim·‘ā·ṭū
verses.literal: Take wives and have sons and daughters Take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage so that they too may have sons and daughters Multiply there do not decrease
verses.literalPt: tomai mulheres e gerai filhos e filhas; tomai mulheres para vossos filhos e dai vossas filhas a maridos, para que tenham filhos e filhas; multiplicai-vos aí e não vos diminuais.

verses.original: וְדִרְשׁ֞וּ אֶת־ שְׁל֣וֹם הָעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִגְלֵ֤יתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה וְהִתְפַּֽלְל֥וּ בַעֲדָ֖הּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י בִשְׁלוֹמָ֔הּ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם שָׁלֽוֹם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏir·šū ’eṯ- šə·lō·wm hā·‘îr ’ă·šer hiḡ·lê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem šām·māh wə·hiṯ·pal·lū ḇa·‘ă·ḏāh ’el- Yah·weh kî ḇiš·lō·w·māh yih·yeh lā·ḵem šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles - Pray to the LORD on its behalf for if it prospers . . . you too will prosper
verses.literalPt: Buscai a paz da cidade, para a qual fiz que fosseis levados cativos, e orai por ela a Jeová; porque, na sua paz, vós tereis paz.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַל־ יַשִּׁ֧יאוּ לָכֶ֛ם נְבִֽיאֵיכֶ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־ בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֖ם וְקֹֽסְמֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַֽל־ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־ חֲלֹמֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם מַחְלְמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’al- yaš·šî·’ū lā·ḵem nə·ḇî·’ê·ḵem ’ă·šer- bə·qir·bə·ḵem wə·qō·sə·mê·ḵem wə·’al- tiš·mə·‘ū ’el- ḥă·lō·mō·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer ’at·tem maḥ·lə·mîm
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Não vos enganem os vossos profetas que estão no meio de vós, e os vossos adivinhadores, nem deis ouvidos aos vossos sonhos que vós sonhais.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְשֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֛ם נִבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶ֖ם בִּשְׁמִ֑י לֹ֥א שְׁלַחְתִּ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·še·qer hêm nib·bə·’îm lā·ḵem biš·mî lō šə·laḥ·tîm nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For they are falsely prophesying . . . to you in My name I have not sent them declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pois eles vos profetizam falsamente em meu nome; não os enviei, diz Jeová.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֠י לְפִ֞י מְלֹ֧את לְבָבֶ֛ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה אֶפְקֹ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־ דְּבָרִ֣י הַטּ֔וֹב לְהָשִׁ֣יב אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh kî lə·p̄î mə·lōṯ lə·ḇā·ḇel šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh ’ep̄·qōḏ ’eṯ·ḵem wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rî haṭ·ṭō·wḇ lə·hā·šîḇ ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says When . . . Babylon’s seventy years are complete I will attend to you and confirm My promise . . . - to restore you to this place
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Logo que forem cumpridos para Babilônia setenta anos, visitar-vos-ei e cumprirei a minha boa palavra dada a vós, fazendo-vos voltar para este lugar.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אָנֹכִ֨י יָדַ֜עְתִּי אֶת־ הַמַּחֲשָׁבֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י חֹשֵׁ֥ב עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה מַחְשְׁב֤וֹת שָׁלוֹם֙ וְלֹ֣א לְרָעָ֔ה לָתֵ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם אַחֲרִ֥ית וְתִקְוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·nō·ḵî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’eṯ- ham·ma·ḥă·šā·ḇōṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî ḥō·šêḇ ‘ă·lê·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ šā·lō·wm wə·lō lə·rā·‘āh lā·ṯêṯ lā·ḵem ’a·ḥă·rîṯ wə·ṯiq·wāh
verses.literal: For I know the plans I have for you declares the LORD plans to prosper you and not to harm you to give you a future and a hope
verses.literalPt: Eu sei os pensamentos que tenho acerca de vós, diz Jeová, pensamentos de paz e não de mal, para vos dar um futuro e uma expectação.

verses.original: וּקְרָאתֶ֤ם אֹתִי֙ וַֽהֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וְהִתְפַּלַּלְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וְשָׁמַעְתִּ֖י אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·qə·rā·ṯem ’ō·ṯî wa·hă·laḵ·tem wə·hiṯ·pal·lal·tem ’ê·lāy wə·šā·ma‘·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me and I will listen to you
verses.literalPt: Invocar-me-eis, e ireis, e orareis a mim, e eu vos ouvirei.

verses.original: וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֹתִ֖י וּמְצָאתֶ֑ם כִּ֥י תִדְרְשֻׁ֖נִי בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiq·qaš·tem ’ō·ṯî ū·mə·ṣā·ṯem kî ṯiḏ·rə·šu·nî bə·ḵāl lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem
verses.literal: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart
verses.literalPt: Buscar-me-eis e me achareis quando me buscardes de todo o vosso coração.

verses.original: וְנִמְצֵ֣אתִי לָכֶם֮ נְאֻם־ יְהוָה֒ וְשַׁבְתִּ֣י אֶת־ שְׁבִיתְכֶם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֶ֠תְכֶם מִֽכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֞ם וּמִכָּל־ הַמְּקוֹמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִדַּ֧חְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֛ם שָׁ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ הִגְלֵ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nim·ṣê·ṯî lā·ḵem nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- šə·ḇī·ṯə·ḵɛm wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kāl hag·gō·w·yim ū·mik·kāl- ham·mə·qō·w·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer hid·daḥ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem šām nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- hiḡ·lê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem miš·šām
verses.literal: I will be found by you declares the LORD and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations . . . and places to which I have banished you - declares the LORD I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile
verses.literalPt: Eu serei achado de vós, diz Jeová, e farei voltar os vossos cativos, e ajuntar-vos-ei de todas as nações e todos os lugares para onde vos tenho lançado, diz Jeová; e far-vos-ei voltar para o lugar donde vos fiz ir para o exílio.

verses.original: כִּ֖י אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם הֵקִ֨ים לָ֧נוּ יְהוָ֛ה נְבִאִ֖ים בָּבֶֽלָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·mar·tem hê·qîm lā·nū Yah·weh nə·ḇi·’îm bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: Because you may say The LORD has raised up for us prophets in Babylon
verses.literalPt: Pois dissestes: Jeová nos suscitou profetas em Babilônia.

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַיּוֹשֵׁב֙ אֶל־ כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֔ד וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את אֲחֵיכֶ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ יָצְא֥וּ אִתְּכֶ֖ם בַּגּוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’el- ham·me·leḵ hay·yō·wō·šêḇ ’el- kis·sê ḏā·wiḏ wə·’el- kāl- hā·‘ām hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ’ă·ḥê·ḵem ’ă·šer lō- yā·ṣə·’ū ’it·tə·ḵem bag·gō·w·lāh
verses.literal: this is what the LORD says about the king who sits on David’s throne and all the people who remain in this city your brothers who did not go with you into exile
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová acerca do rei que se assenta sobre o trono de Davi e acerca de todo o povo que habita nesta cidade, a saber, vossos irmãos que não saíram conosco para o exílio;

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִי֙ מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ בָּ֔ם אֶת־ הַחֶ֖רֶב אֶת־ הָרָעָ֣ב וְאֶת־ הַדָּ֑בֶר וְנָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֗ם כַּתְּאֵנִים֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵאָכַ֖לְנָה מֵרֹֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hin·nî mə·šal·lê·aḥ bām ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ ’eṯ- hā·rā·‘āḇ wə·’eṯ- had·dā·ḇer wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·w·ṯām kat·tə·’ê·nîm haš·šō·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·’ā·ḵal·nāh mê·rō·a‘
verses.literal: this is what the LORD of Hosts . . . says I will send against them sword and famine and plague and I will make them like rotten figs so bad they cannot be eaten
verses.literalPt: assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos: Eis que vou enviar sobre eles a espada, a fome e a peste e fá-los-ei como figos péssimos, que não se podem comer, de ruins que são.

verses.original: וְרָֽדַפְתִּי֙ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם בַּחֶ֖רֶב בָּרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וּנְתַתִּ֨ים לִזְוָעָה לְכֹ֣ל׀ מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֗רֶץ לְאָלָ֤ה וּלְשַׁמָּה֙ וְלִשְׁרֵקָ֣ה וּלְחֶרְפָּ֔ה בְּכָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ הִדַּחְתִּ֥ים שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḏap̄·tî ’a·ḥă·rê·hem ba·ḥe·reḇ bā·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇad·dā·ḇer ū·nə·ṯat·tîm liz·wå̄·ʿå̄h lə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lə·’ā·lāh ū·lə·šam·māh wə·liš·rê·qāh ū·lə·ḥer·pāh bə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- hid·daḥ·tîm šām
verses.literal: I will pursue them with sword and famine and plague I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth a curse a desolation and an object of scorn and reproach among all the nations to which I banish them . . .
verses.literalPt: Persegui-los-ei com a espada, com a fome e com a peste e fá-los-ei um espetáculo horrendo para todos os reinos da terra, e objeto de execração, e de espanto, e de assobios, e de opróbrio, entre todas as nações para onde os tenho lançado;

verses.original: תַּ֛חַת אֲשֶֽׁר־ לֹא־ שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶל־ דְּבָרַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־ עֲבָדַ֤י הַנְּבִאִים֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְשָׁלֹ֔חַ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer- lō- šā·mə·‘ū ’el- də·ḇā·ray nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ă·šer šā·laḥ·tî ’ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay han·nə·ḇi·’îm haš·kêm wə·šā·lō·aḥ wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will do this because they have not listened to My words declares the LORD which I sent to them again and again . . . through My servants the prophets And neither have you exiles listened declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: porque não escutaram as minhas palavras, diz Jeová, com as quais lhes enviei os meus servos, os profetas, levantando-me cedo e enviando-os. Na verdade, não escutaram, diz Jeová.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֖ם שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה כָּל־ הַ֨גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי מִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh kāl- hag·gō·w·lāh ’ă·šer- šil·laḥ·tî mî·rū·šā·lim bā·ḇe·lāh
verses.literal: So hear the word of the LORD all you exiles I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, pois, a palavra de Jeová, vós todos os exilados que enviei de Jerusalém para Babilônia.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־ אַחְאָ֤ב בֶּן־ קֽוֹלָיָה֙ וְאֶל־ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־ מַֽעֲשֵׂיָ֔ה הַֽנִּבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶ֛ם בִּשְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑קֶר הִנְנִ֣י׀ נֹתֵ֣ן אֹתָ֗ם בְּיַד֙ נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְהִכָּ֖ם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ ben- qō·w·lā·yāh wə·’el- ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ḇen- ma·‘ă·śê·yāh han·nib·bə·’îm lā·ḵem biš·mî šā·qer hin·nî nō·ṯên ’ō·ṯām bə·yaḏ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel wə·hik·kām lə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah who are prophesying to you lies . . . in My name I will deliver them to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and he will kill them before your very eyes
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, acerca de Acabe, filho de Colaías, e acerca de Zedequias, filho de Maaseias, que vos profetizam mentiras em meu nome: Eis que os entregarei nas mãos de Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia; e ele fará matá-los diante dos vossos olhos.

verses.original: וְלֻקַּ֤ח מֵהֶם֙ קְלָלָ֔ה לְכֹל֙ גָּל֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבָבֶ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר יְשִֽׂמְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ כְּצִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ וּכְאֶחָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־ קָלָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·luq·qaḥ mê·hem qə·lā·lāh lə·ḵōl gā·lūṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer bə·ḇā·ḇel lê·mōr yə·śim·ḵā Yah·weh kə·ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ū·ḵə·’e·ḥāḇ ’ă·šer- qā·lām me·leḵ- bā·ḇel bā·’êš
verses.literal: Because of them all the exiles of Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse . . . May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and Ahab whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire
verses.literalPt: Deles será formulada uma maldição por todos os exilados de Judá que estão em Babilônia, dizendo: Faça-te Jeová como a Zedequias e como a Acabe, os quais o rei de Babilônia assou no fogo;

verses.original: יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשׂ֨וּ נְבָלָ֜ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיְנַֽאֲפוּ֙ אֶת־ נְשֵׁ֣י רֵֽעֵיהֶ֔ם וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ דָבָ֤ר בִּשְׁמִי֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר ל֣וֹא צִוִּיתִ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֛י הוּיֹדֵעַ וָעֵ֖ד נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū nə·ḇā·lāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·na·’ă·p̄ū ’eṯ- nə·šê rê·‘ê·hem way·ḏab·bə·rū ḏā·ḇār biš·mî še·qer ’ă·šer lō·w ṣiw·wî·ṯim wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hū·yō·ḏē·aʿ wā·‘êḏ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For they have committed an outrage in Israel by committing adultery with the wives of their neighbors and speaking . . . lies in My name which I did not command them to do I am He who knows and I am a witness declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: porque cometeram insensatez em Israel, e adulteraram com as mulheres dos seus próximos, e falaram falsamente em meu nome palavras que não lhes mandei. Eu é que sei e sou testemunha, diz Jeová.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ שְׁמַעְיָ֥הוּ הַנֶּחֱלָמִ֖י תֹּאמַ֥ר לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- šə·ma‘·yā·hū han·ne·ḥĕ·lā·mî tō·mar lê·mōr
verses.literal: You are to tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite that
verses.literalPt: A Semaías, neelamita, dirás:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּה֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתָּ בְשִׁמְכָ֜ה סְפָרִ֗ים אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְאֶל־ צְפַנְיָ֤ה בֶן־ מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶ֥ל כָּל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ya·‘an ’ă·šer ’at·tāh šā·laḥ·tā ḇə·šim·ḵāh sə·p̄ā·rîm ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim wə·’el- ṣə·p̄an·yāh ḇen- ma·‘ă·śê·yāh hak·kō·hên wə·’el kāl- hak·kō·hă·nîm lê·mōr
verses.literal: this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says - In your own name you have sent out letters to all the people of Jerusalem to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah and to all the priests You said to Zephaniah
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Porquanto tu enviaste em teu nome cartas a todo o povo que está em Jerusalém, e a Sofonias, filho do sacerdote Maaseias, e a todos os sacerdotes, dizendo:

verses.original: יְהוָ֞ה נְתָנְךָ֣ כֹהֵ֗ן תַּ֚חַת יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לִֽהְי֤וֹת פְּקִדִים֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְכָל־ אִ֥ישׁ מְשֻׁגָּ֖ע וּמִתְנַבֵּ֑א וְנָתַתָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ אֶל־ הַמַּהְפֶּ֖כֶת וְאֶל־ הַצִּינֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh nə·ṯā·nə·ḵā ḵō·hên ta·ḥaṯ yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên lih·yō·wṯ pə·qi·ḏîm bêṯ Yah·weh lə·ḵāl ’îš mə·šug·gā‘ ū·miṯ·nab·bê wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·ṯōw ’el- ham·mah·pe·ḵeṯ wə·’el- haṣ·ṣî·nōq
verses.literal: The LORD has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada to be the chief officer in the house of the LORD responsible for any madman . . . who acts like a prophet you must put him in stocks . . . and neck irons
verses.literalPt: Jeová te constituiu sacerdote em lugar do sacerdote Joiada, para que fosses encarregado da Casa de Jeová, no tocante a todo homem que está fora de si e profetiza, a fim de que o metas no cepo e no tronco;

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה לָ֚מָּה לֹ֣א גָעַ֔רְתָּ בְּיִרְמְיָ֖הוּ הָֽעֲנְּתֹתִ֑י הַמִּתְנַבֵּ֖א לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lām·māh lō ḡā·‘ar·tā bə·yir·mə·yā·hū hā·‘ăn·nə·ṯō·ṯî ham·miṯ·nab·bê lā·ḵem
verses.literal: So now why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth who poses as a prophet among you
verses.literalPt: agora, pois, por que não repreendeste a Jeremias de Anatote, que vos profetiza?

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַל־ כֵּ֞ן שָׁלַ֥ח אֵלֵ֛ינוּ בָּבֶ֥ל לֵאמֹ֖ר אֲרֻכָּ֣ה הִ֑יא בְּנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְשֵׁ֔בוּ וְנִטְע֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְאִכְל֖וּ אֶת־ פְּרִיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘al- kên šā·laḥ ’ê·lê·nū bā·ḇel lê·mōr ’ă·ruk·kāh hî bə·nū ḇāt·tîm wə·šê·ḇū wə·niṭ·‘ū ḡan·nō·wṯ wə·’iḵ·lū ’eṯ- pə·rî·hen
verses.literal: For . . . . . . he has sent to us in Babylon claiming Since the exile will be lengthy build houses and settle down plant gardens and eat their produce
verses.literalPt: Pois enviou mensageiros a vós, em Babilônia, a dizer: Coisa dilatada é; edificai casas e habitai nelas; plantai jardins e comei o fruto deles.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א צְפַנְיָ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה בְּאָזְנֵ֖י יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ṣə·p̄an·yāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- has·sê·p̄er haz·zeh bə·’ā·zə·nê yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî
verses.literal: Zephaniah the priest however, had read this letter to Jeremiah the prophet
verses.literalPt: Sofonias, o sacerdote, leu esta carta aos ouvidos do profeta Jeremias.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, veio a palavra de Jeová a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: שְׁלַ֤ח עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹלָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ שְׁמַעְיָ֖ה הַנֶּחֱלָמִ֑י יַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ נִבָּ֨א לָכֶ֜ם שְׁמַעְיָ֗ה וַֽאֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א שְׁלַחְתִּ֔יו וַיַּבְטַ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם עַל־ שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: šə·laḥ ‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·lāh lê·mōr kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’el- šə·ma‘·yāh han·ne·ḥĕ·lā·mî ya·‘an ’ă·šer nib·bā lā·ḵem šə·ma‘·yāh wa·’ă·nî lō šə·laḥ·tîw way·yaḇ·ṭaḥ ’eṯ·ḵem ‘al- šā·qer
verses.literal: Send a message telling all the exiles what the LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you though I did not send him and has made you trust in a lie
verses.literalPt: Manda dizer a todos os exilados: Assim diz Jeová acerca de Semaías, neelamita: Porquanto vos profetizou Semaías, e eu não o enviei, e ele fez que vós confiásseis numa mentira,

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י פֹקֵ֜ד עַל־ שְׁמַעְיָ֣ה הַנֶּחֱלָמִי֮ וְעַל־ זַרְעוֹ֒ לֹא־ יִהְיֶ֨ה ל֜וֹ אִ֣ישׁ׀ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב׀ בְּתוֹךְ־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה וְלֹֽא־ יִרְאֶ֥ה בַטּ֛וֹב אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶֽׂה־ לְעַמִּ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־ סָרָ֥ה דִבֶּ֖ר עַל־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî p̄ō·qêḏ ‘al- šə·ma‘·yāh han·ne·ḥĕ·lā·mî wə·‘al- zar·‘ōw lō- yih·yeh lōw ’îš yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ṯō·wḵ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·lō- yir·’eh ḇaṭ·ṭō·wḇ ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh- lə·‘am·mî nə·’um- Yah·weh kî- sā·rāh ḏib·ber ‘al- Yah·weh
verses.literal: this is what the LORD says I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite . . . and his descendants He will have no one left among this people nor will he see the good that I will bring to My people declares the LORD for he has preached rebellion against the LORD
verses.literalPt: portanto assim diz Jeová: Eis que castigarei a Semaías, neelamita, e a sua posteridade. Não haverá dele varão que habite entre este povo, nem verá ele o bem que hei de fazer ao meu povo, diz Jeová, porque pregou rebelião contra Jeová.
